identity.title: Laboratory spectroscopic study and astronomical detection of vibrationally excited n-propyl cyanide

paper_type_evidence.quote: We recorded laboratory rotational spectra of *n*-propyl cyanide in two spectral windows between 36 and 127 GHz. We searched for emission lines produced by these states in the ALMA spectrum of Sagittarius B2(N2).

question.value: Determine spectroscopic parameters of low-lying vibrational states of both n-propyl cyanide conformers in the laboratory and search for these states in ALMA EMoCA data toward Sgr B2(N2)

evidence.quote: We wanted to determine spectroscopic parameters of low-lying vibrational states of both conformers of *n*-propyl cyanide to search for them in our ALMA data.
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00017.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00012.S
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00017.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00012.S
to perform a spectral line survey of Sgr B2(N) between 84.1 and 114.4 GHz
The high angular resolution ($\sim$1.6$''$)

provided.value: Rotational spectra of n-PrCN 36-70 GHz and 89-127 GHz

evidence.quote: we recorded rotational spectra of *n*-PrCN in two spectral windows, 36 to 70 GHz and 89 to 127 GHz

what.value: Ground state spectroscopic parameters of n-PrCN

evidence.quote: The ground state rotational and centrifugal distortion parameters of *n*-PrCN were taken from (cite: det-PrCN_EtFo)
Scaled values from a quantum chemical calculation (cite: n-PrCN_IR_etc_2001) were taken for vibrational energies of the lowest three fundamental modes

what.value: Observations, reduction and analysis method of full EMoCA data set

evidence.quote: A detailed account of the observations, reduction, and analysis method of the full data set covering 84.1 to 114.4 GHz was reported by (cite: deuterated_SgrB2N2_2016).

what.value: LTE parameters of vibrational ground state (source size 1.0'', 150 K, 5 km/s, 73.5 km/s)

evidence.quote: A source size of 1.0$\ensuremath{''}$ was derived by (cite: i-PrCN_det_2014) from Gaussian fits

unstated_but_needed: ALMA calibration, CASA version and imaging parameters (deferred to Belloche et al. 2016)
Software used for LTE modeling (e.g. XCLASS/WEEDS) not named
Spectral extraction position for Sgr B2(N2)

method.value: Fit vibrational changes relative to fixed ground state parameters, with Coriolis and Fermi terms for v18=1/v30=2

evidence.quote: Using ground state spectroscopic parameters and fitting the vibrational changes has two distinct advantages.

method.value: Same LTE parameters as ground state applied to vibrationally excited states

evidence.quote: Using the same LTE parameters as for the vibrational ground state, we looked for lines from within vibrationally excited states

key_parameters.value: T = 150 K, linewidth 5 km/s, velocity 73.5 km/s, source size 1.0''

evidence.quote: with a temperature of 150 K, a linewidth of 5 km s$^{-1}$, and a velocity of 73.5 km s$^{-1}$
The spectrum was well-fit under the local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) approximation

validation.value: All states well fit with same parameters

evidence.quote: The fact that the lines of all states, including the vibrational ground state, are well-fit with the same parameters, gives us confidence
We used Pickett’s SPCAT and SPFIT programs (cite: spfit_1991) to predict and fit rotational spectra
leading to a column density of $1.7 \times 10^{17}$ cm$^{-2}$ after correction
A fit to this diagram yields a temperature of 142 $\pm$ 4 K.
The experimentally determined energy difference of $33.956 \pm 0.020$ cm$^{-1}$ between these two states

findings_qualitative.value: All eight vibrationally excited states detected toward Sgr B2(N2); far-infrared pumping not important

evidence.quote: far-infrared pumping is, at least, not so important that it alters the apparent vibrational temperature

claims.hypothesis: Vibrationally excited n-PrCN states can be detected in the ALMA data
claims.experiment: Lab spectroscopy then LTE modeling of the EMoCA spectrum
claims.result: Lines of all eight excited states detected
claims.finding: All states reproduced by the same LTE model

evidence.quote: we report the detection of one or several transitions or groups of transitions of each of the eight vibrationally excited states

limitations_admitted.value: v28=1 gauche and some anti b-type lines could not be fit well

evidence.quote: Their frequencies could not be reproduced with one set of reasonable spectroscopic parameters.

referee_caveats_inferred: Some states rest on a single line

data_public_as_stated.value: Interferometric data available in the ALMA archive

evidence.quote: The interferometric data are available in the ALMA archive at https://almascience.eso.org/aq/.

missing_for_reproduction: Reduction details in Belloche et al. 2016
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public but the ALMA processing is inherited and LTE software is unnamed.
